interaction_steps.prompt:
If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'PROJECT_BRIEF.md' -g 'go.mod' -g '*resolver*' -g '*clientconn*' | head -80 && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' resolver/resolver.go && rg -n \"Report|resolver.*Err|ResolveNow|UpdateState|NewClient|failfast|pickFirst|resolver\" clientconn.go clientconn_test.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go resolver_conn_wrapper_test.go | head -240"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,190p' resolver_conn_wrapper.go; sed -n '480,620p' clientconn.go; sed -n '800,850p' clientconn.go; rg -n \"type picker|blockingPicker|ErrTransientFailure|ErrNoSubConnAvailable|pick\\(\" *.go balancer -g '*.go' | head -200; git log -8 --oneline"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,230p' picker_wrapper.go; sed -n '70,125p' pickfirst.go; sed -n '1,120p' resolver/manual/manual.go; sed -n '1,180p' resolver_conn_wrapper_test.go; rg -n \"firstResolveEvent|updateResolverState|UpdateBalancerState|State struct\" --glob '*.go'"
/bin/zsh -lc "git log -1 --format='%H %ad %s' --date=iso && git remote -v && git branch -a --contains HEAD | head"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '120,270p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go; sed -n '1,130p' balancer/base/balancer.go; sed -n '280,350p' balancer/balancer_v1_wrapper.go 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n \"func \\(.*updateClientConnState|updateClientConnState\" balancer_conn_wrappers.go balancer_v1_wrapper.go"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fsck --no-reflogs --unreachable 2>/dev/null | head -30; git tag --contains HEAD | head'

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"HandleResolvedAddrs|type Balancer|V2Balancer\" balancer/balancer.go balancer_v1_wrapper.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go; sed -n '1,110p' balancer_v1_wrapper.go; sed -n '130,230p' balancer/balancer.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '245,310p' balancer_v1_wrapper.go; sed -n '260,330p' balancer/balancer.go; sed -n '1,90p' balancer/roundrobin/roundrobin.go; rg -n \"ErrTransientFailure|HandleResolvedAddrs\" --glob '*.go' | head -100"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '35,75p' pickfirst.go; sed -n '380,420p' balancer/grpclb/grpclb.go; sed -n '1,130p' xds/internal/balancer/xds.go | tail -50"
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go balancer/base/balancer.go pickfirst.go && go test ./resolver/... ./balancer/... ./...'
/bin/zsh -lc 'go test ./resolver/... ./balancer/... ./...'
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"type testClientConn struct|func \\(.*testClientConn\\).*UpdateState|func \\(.*testClientConn\\).*NewAddress\" resolver xds --glob '*_test.go'"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,80p' resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go; sed -n '55,78p' xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go"
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && go test -vet=off ./resolver/... ./balancer/... ./...'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff && go test -vet=off . ./balancer/base ./balancer/roundrobin ./resolver/dns ./xds/internal/resolver'
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'
